reason: Holding the Round 3 book unchanged: 12% MSFT long with a 12% stop and 30% take-profit, and 88% cash. Research was limited, but it did confirm one point: MSFT traded around $531-533 on 2026-10-26 and 10-27 and was marked at $521.91 on 10-30, so the leg is down 2.2% from entry and well inside its stop. Reported items include an earnings date on 10-27 after the close and a voluntary buyout offer to about 60,000 staff. I did not find the actual fiscal Q1 2027 results or the post-report reaction, so I cannot judge whether the 10-30 mark reflects a fundamental change or a post-earnings move. Adding or exiting now without that information would be guesswork. The cash position is consistent with the hawkish-rate backdrop. Holding and revisiting once the earnings reaction is confirmed.
